newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Tennessee had better Q1 operating profits.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Tennessee had better Q1 operating profits.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said Wednesday El Paso Tennessee Pipeline Co had first quarter net income of $30 million, compared with $24 million for the year-ago period after excluding non-recurring transactions.
Non-recurring transactions in the first quarter of 1996 included the $42 million in net gains from the sale of certain stock and partnership investments, El Paso said.
Operating income for the first quarter of 1997 totaled $76 million, compared with $63 million for the same period in 1996.
El Paso said the pipeline's regulated operations contributed most of the increase in earnings arising from revised rates on the Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co system and lower operating costs.
